}}'''Climbing''' is a tier one [[technology]] that unlocks [[movement]] and a [[defence bonus]] in mountain tiles and reveals metal, a resource used by the [[Mine]].

The [[Xin-xi]] [[tribe]] starts with Climbing.

== History ==
In [[Update History|update 2.0.57]], the defence bonus in mountain tiles was moved from [[Meditation]] to Climbing.
